parole.significato: Schizomycetes; all or some bacteria, in any of several phyla.
parole.testo: Compound of klyva (“split, cleave”) + svamp (“fungus”). Calque of taxonomic name Schizomycetes. Ultimately from Ancient Greek σχίζω (skhízō, “I split”) + plural form of μύκης (múkēs, “mushroom, fungus, mushroom-shaped objects”). Refers to bacteria's habit of multiplying by splitting. First attested
From taxonomic name Metazoa, from Ancient Greek μετα- (meta-) + ζῶον (zôon). Originally coined by Ernst Haeckel.
